rv.q: There is so much about this production that I absolutely love, I’m sure I must be missing something.

Jones an utter chameleon who is the Soothsayer, Caius Ligarius, Octavius’s attendant and Strato. A round of applause to the quick changes and the costume designs by Emily Bloomer– there is great skill in convincing an upclose audience that these people represent so many characters and great costumes help immensely.

Although this production is not as successful as it could have been, what it resolves to do is much more creative and interesting than if the troupe had stuck to Shakespeare’s original story and costuming.

cn.t: Invictus Theatre's modern-dress "Julius Caesar" delivers a visceral, politically charged production that feels ripped from today's headlines. Critics praise the ambitious staging and relevance, though some question the heavy-handed contemporary parallels.
